title: Swiss wellness · closed loop
audience: clinic / brand / investor — premium wellness face + closed loop

segments.en: In a quiet clinic, care is meant to feel calm.
But calm alone does not close the loop.
Recovery belongs in the protocol — rest you can feel, and later measure.
Food enters as medicine. A plate. A photograph. A sentence. Logged — not left to memory.
Glucose joins the same picture — the curve beside the meal.
Heart rate and activity from the watch change today's targets.
At night, sleep closes the day. The week remains visible.
This is Healthings. Sensor, scale, meals, labs, and movement — fused into today's numbers.
When new data lands, the plan steers back to the clinician's rules. Hard floors. Hard caps. Theirs.
High-end calm. A closed loop. The whole week — before the patient sits down.
